violation_type.title: Written Operational Policies - Discipline (26 TAC §746.501(a)(7))
violation_type.typical_finding: It has been found that parents did not receive updated operational policies in regards to discipline.

finding_variants.text: It has been found that parents did not receive updated operational policies in regards to discipline.
It was found that the Operational Policies did not discipline policy listed or minimum standards 746.501(9)(12)(18)(22)(24)(26)(27)(28) and (30).
The operational policies did not have any information for parents on the operations discipline policy.

Operational Policies were reviewed and the following information is missing / need clarification:    (7) Discipline and Guidance  (8) Suspension and Expulsion  (9) Safe Sleep Policy  (11) Immunization requirements  (12) Hearing and Vision Screening Requirements  (13) Enrollment Procedures including notifying parent of policy changes  (14) Transportation  (15) Water Activities  (16) Field Trips  (17) Animals  (18) Promotion of indoor and outdoor play  (a) Benefits  (b) Duration  (c) Type of physical activity  (d) Each setting  (e) Recommended clothing  (g) A plan to ensure physical activity  (19) Procedures for providing and applying insect repellent and sunscreen  (22) Procedures for parents to review most recent licensing inspection  (23) Instructions on how parents may contact the local licensing office  (25) Provisions to provide comfortable place that enables a mother to breastfeed  (26) Preventing and responding to abuse and neglect of children including  (A) REquired annual training for employees  (B) Methods of increasing employee and parent awareness of issues regarding child abuse  (C) Prevention techniques  (D) Strategies for coordination  (E) Actions a parent can take  (27) Procedures for conducting health checks  (28) Information on vaccine-preventable diseases  (29) Epinephrine Auto-Injectors  (30) Procedures for supporting inclusive services   (b) Gang free zone
Operational polcies did not include information for discipline and guidance.
The operation did not have a operational policies for viewing with all required information.
